display_name: Pattern B E/T PROGRESSED Candidate V1

frozen_rule.entry: Pattern B DEPRESSED AND current Pattern A Stage PROGRESSED AND previous authoritative Pattern A Stage in {EARLY_TREND, TRANSITION}
frozen_rule.exit: Pattern B NORMAL observed while held, then next exact KRX session open

portfolio.portfolio_aware_signal_stream: all frozen allowed candidate signals remain in chronological stream; actual active identity and current cash determine each execution; cash-skipped identities remain flat and later signals are reevaluated
portfolio.sale_proceeds_settlement: next exact KRX session; unavailable to same-open entries
portfolio.within_day_order: release previously settled proceeds; exits; buys ordered by exact signal-date KRX market cap descending then ticker and pair id

valuation.approved_same_date_exchange_status_carry: only when common rule evidence authorizes it; audit required
valuation.coverage_formula: valid whole-portfolio equity trading days / total effective-window trading days
valuation.daily_mark: exact Repository V2 close; if any held position cannot be marked, the whole portfolio equity day is unresolved
valuation.unresolved_equity_day_policy: exclude the entire day from Observed MDD; no missing-position omission, zero fill, nearest date, interpolation, or arbitrary carry

window.support_policy: only an exit signal dated on or before effective_end may fill on execution_support; entries after effective_end are not filled
